items.title: Unit 1 · Story
items.scene: I can put away the ___ and put up the flag.
items.prompt: Listen to the story. Which word fills the gap?
items.spokenPrompt: Listen. Which word fills the gap?
items.spokenScene: I can put away the blanket and put up the flag.
items.storyText: The fly, the crab, and the crocodile are friends. This is their club. Our club is a mess. We need to clean up! I can use the broom to sweep. I can put away the blanket and put up the flag. I can wipe the globe with a rag. Now our club is clean! Look at the clock. It's time to eat!
items.why: In “The Club”, you hear: I can put away the blanket and put up the flag. The missing word is “blanket”.
items.hint: Listen to this part again, or play the whole story.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 4, Unit 1, p.11 · Titi narration of the supplied textbook text
